description: This file defines a class Goteo\Util\Google\GoogleGeocoder that provides a static method to fetch geographical coordinates and address components from the Google Geocoding API based on input parameters.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Google\GoogleGeocoder
classes.description: A utility class for interacting with Google Geocoding API to retrieve address components and coordinates.

methods.name: getCoordinates
methods.description: Retrieves latitude, longitude, city, country, country code, and region from Google Geocoding API based on provided parameters.
